evidence.quote: The George Tavern is a historic, independent live music venue and vibrant community cultural hub located in East London
On quieter evenings, it operates as a candlelit pub space
The space hosts a wide range of genres, including indie, art rock, synth-pop, punk, and UK rap.
Gothic post punk from Berlin, with three support acts
Indie pop gig with support, plus karaoke until late

findings.value: Mostly live bands: album launches, bills of two to four acts, and multi-night tribute runs (the Halloweekender, with local bands covering one act a night). Free karaoke on Thursdays, plus DJ parties and club nights on Fridays and Saturdays, sometimes with live music as well.

evidence.quote: Beyond concerts and album launch parties, the venue facilitates creative programming like karaoke nights, performance art, and singles mixers.
Local bands cover Bruce Springsteen, Kate Bush, and a BJM vs Dandy Warhols clash.
A marathon session of live music and DJ sets from the Bathtime crew.
